home.title: Math Kingdom
home.subtitle: Where numbers come alive and math is magical
home.footer1: Every adventure teaches real mathematical ideas through play and wonder.
home.footer2: Pick an open adventure to begin your journey.

infinity.title: Hilbert's Amazing Hotel
infinity.description: Visit the hotel that always has room for one more guest — even when it is completely full. Discover infinity with a parade of animal guests and one very determined unicorn.

primes.title: The Prime Number Orchestra
primes.description: Conduct an orchestra where instruments only play on prime numbers. Find the mysterious rhythm of 2, 3, 5, 7, 11… and turn it into music.

fractal.title: The Fractal Pizza Palace
fractal.description: Slice a pizza that contains endless copies of itself. Zoom into a world where the same pattern repeats forever, at every size.

probability.title: The Probability Carnival
probability.description: Join friendly monsters at carnival games. Predict outcomes, spin wheels, and learn why some things are more likely to happen than others.

fibonacci.title: The Fibonacci Bunny Garden
fibonacci.description: Watch rabbits multiply in nature's most beautiful pattern, and find the golden spiral hiding in flowers, shells, and galaxies.

topology.title: Topology Space Adventure
topology.description: Travel with alien friends who bend and stretch shapes without breaking them. Watch a coffee cup turn into a donut and learn what "the same shape" really means.

graphs.title: Graph Theory Kingdom
graphs.description: Help knights and dragons travel between castles. Solve the famous bridge puzzle and learn how mathematicians map connections.

mystery.title: The Secret Math Mystery
mystery.description: A surprise adventure awaits explorers who finish every other quest. What mathematical magic hides in the final challenge?
